issue_title: [Bug] Race condition: next_id() can generate duplicate IDs in concurrent scenarios
fix_summary: Fixed race condition in next_id() by implementing file-level locking in the new add_todo() method, making the load-compute-save sequence atomic.

storage.py.description: Added add_todo() method with FileLock to ensure atomic ID generation

cli.py.description: Updated TodoApp.add() to delegate to atomic add_todo() method

uv.lock.description: Updated lock file with filelock dependency

approach: Used filelock library (already in dependencies) to wrap the load-compute-save sequence in add_todo(), preventing TOCTOU race condition where concurrent processes could generate duplicate IDs.
risks: None - the fix uses existing filelock dependency and only affects the add operation. Other operations (mark_done, remove, etc.) are not affected by ID generation issues.
limitations: File-level locking only works for operations on the same storage file. Distributed systems would need a different synchronization mechanism.
